Mirrors incoming UDP packets back to the source for connectivity testing.

# Purpose
`fd_udpecho_tile` defines a tile that reads incoming Ethernet frames from one input link, checks that they contain IPv4 UDP datagrams, and publishes a new frame that sends the UDP payload back to the source address and source port. The code builds a new Ethernet, IPv4, and UDP header, copies the payload, and stores the output packet size in the tile context. It also keeps track of the output destination address so the packet can be published on the correct network mux signature.

The file is a tile implementation for the `fd_topo` and `fd_stem` framework, not a standalone executable. It defines the tile context, scratch space size and alignment, unprivileged setup, packet processing callbacks, and the `fd_topo_run_tile_t` descriptor named `fd_tile_udpecho`. The tile accepts one input and one output link, and it uses compact dcache chunk management to place each echoed packet into the output workspace.
